demoText: log in with a test account (invented data, nothing is sent):
forgotText: Enter your account’s e-mail. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotSent: Sent. If an account exists with this e-mail, you will get an e-mail in a few minutes (check your spam too). The link works for 30 minutes. You can change your password 2 times a month; after that, the e-mail will tell you to ask your supervisor.

resetMismatch: The two passwords are not the same
resetDone: Done! Your password is changed. Log in with the new one.
